name: Tipo de Valor de Venta (Resumen Diario)
source: Anexo 8 (catálogo 11) from the 'Catálogos' sheet of perunio-facturador/resources/reglas/reglas-validacion-cpe-2026-08-26.xlsx: the tipo de valor de venta each sac:BillingPayment/cbc:InstructionID of a resumen diario (RC 1.1) declares. ERROR 2256 checks it against Parámetro 017, which is this catálogo, and ERROR 2357 rejects the same código twice on one line. 06-09 are new and valid only from 2027-01-01, when 05 (Gratuitas) is deactivated in their favour — the workbook strikes 05 through (Control de Cambios of 24.04.2026, postponed from 2026-08-01 on 24.07.2026). `emit` marks what perunio-facturador's RC builder puts on the wire today (internal/xmlbuilder/summary.go): 01, 02, 03 and 05 — it does not summarise exportaciones, so 04 is display-only. By 2027-01-01, 05 must become `retired` and 06-09 `emit`, released together with the builder change that splits the gratuitas (perunio-facturador spec case summary/08, deviation F13).
